capabilities: insert a line break inside a table cell via a command
run the command from the Ribbon menu
run the command from the Command Palette
assign the command to a shortcut or mobile toolbar icon
extras:
The README references a screenshot of the enter-key icon; the command uses the HTML
element rather than native Markdown.
motivation: The README states that SHIFT+ENTER works only with a hardware keyboard, so the author added a command to provide this ability on devices without one.
problem: On mobile devices there is no way to press SHIFT+ENTER, so multi-line text inside a single table cell cannot be typed.
summary:
Single-command plugin that inserts an HTML
line break inside a table cell, aimed at mobile devices without a hardware keyboard.
